title: IOE Lớp 7 - Chuyên đề 1 - Vòng Quốc Gia

part_A.question: The stomachache prevented Mr. Thanh _ _ _ _ enjoying the meal.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "from" → "prevent + O + FROM + V-ing" (ngăn ai làm gì).

part_A.question: The weather is warm enough for us ….
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "to go out B. to going out C. going out D. go out" → "adj + enough + to V" (đủ ... để làm gì). KHÔNG dùng "for/going".

part_A.question: Where _ _ _ _ you yesterday evening? I didn’t see you.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "were" → "were" = thì quá khứ của "to be". "was" (I/he/she/it), "were" (we/you/they). Dấu hiệu: yesterday.

part_A.question: There is too much _ _ _ _ _ in my coffee. It is too sweet.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "sugar" → "sugar" = đường (danh từ không đếm được → dùng "much", không dùng "many").

part_A.question: _ _ _ _ does she iron her clothes? – On Sundays.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "When" → Từ để hỏi "When" → câu trả lời "On Sundays." cho thấy đây là hỏi về thời gian.

part_A.question: Every day the doctor has to … surgery on different patients.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "perform" → "perform surgery" = thực hiện ca phẫu thuật. KHÔNG dùng "operate/create/cause".

part_A.question: ... call her later. She’s not home now.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "Please B. Have C. Do D. Is"

part_A.question: Does this drug have any unpleasant …?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "side effects" → "side effects": tác dụng phụ (effects, không phải affects = ảnh hưởng đến).

part_A.question: This is the second time I ir_ _ _ _ the clothes for myself.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "oned" → Từ đầy đủ: "ironed" = đã ủi – quá khứ của iron (ủi quần áo).

part_A.question: Spring is coming and the weather is getting ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "warmer" → "warmer": ấm hơn (so sánh hơn của "warm"). | So sánh hơn tính từ ngắn: dùng "-er" (→ "warmer"), KHÔNG dùng "more + tính từ-er" (lỗi kép). | "warmer" là so sánh hơn đúng của "warm" (warm → warmer). "more warmer" là sai (lỗi kép). "warmest" là so sánh nhất.

part_A.question: We usually _ _ _ _ a picnic when we have free time.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "have" → "have" = "have a picnic/have fun..." (cụm danh động từ) hoặc thì hiện tại hoàn thành.

part_A.question: I have fewer stamps _ _ _ _ he does.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "than" → "fewer ... THAN" = so sánh hơn với danh từ đếm được.

part_A.question: These symptoms will di_ _ _ _ ear after you take these pills
part_A.explanation: Điền: "sapp" → Từ đầy đủ: "disappear" = biến mất – di + sapp + ear.

part_A.question: We can see planes parking in the ....
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "airport B. railway station C. bus stop D. stadium"

part_A.question: She is not the kind of _ _ _ _ _ y person. She likes lying in bed and reading books.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "sport" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: She is not the kind of [sport] _ _ _ _ y person. She likes lying in bed and reading books.

part_A.question: Tom: How does Nam go to school? - Loan: He w_ _ _ _ to school every morning.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "alks" → Từ đầy đủ: "walks" = đi bộ – he walks to school.

part_A.question: We have fun ... games together.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "playing" → "have fun / enjoy + V-ing": động từ theo sau phải ở dạng -ing.

part_A.question: I have a bad cold. I keep snee_ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "zing" → Từ đầy đủ: "sneezing" = hắt hơi.

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ did he give you? - He gave me 20 dollars.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "much" → "How much" hỏi về số lượng không đếm được.

part_A.question: What’s the … of Mexico City?- 12 million people.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "populations" → "populations": số dân, dân số (ở đây dùng dạng số nhiều theo câu hỏi).

part_A.question: My school is at ….
options: C. a village far from here
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "30 Hoang Hoa Tham Road B. Hoan Kiem District C. a village far from here D. Nam Dinh Province"

part_A.question: ... my house, there’s a large garden.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Behind"

part_A.question: What’s the weather _ _ _ _ in winter? – It’s very cold.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "like" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: What’s the weather [like] _ _ _ in winter? – It’s very cold.

part_A.question: Jane and Jack stood in _ _ _ _ _ of the mirror and looked at themselves.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "front" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Jane and Jack stood in [front] _ _ _ _ of the mirror and looked at themselves.

part_A.question: I often have a runny _ _ _ _ when I catch the flu.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "nose" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: I often have a runny [nose] _ _ _ when I catch the flu.

part_A.question: Could you give me some cookies? - _ _ _ _ you are.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "here" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Could you give me some cookies? - [here] _ _ _ you are.

part_A.question: Your application must be made _ _ _ _ 3 copies for handling by our company.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "into" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Your application must be made [into] _ _ _ 3 copies for handling by our company.

part_A.question: Today, we’ll just ... the final scene of the play.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "rehearse"

part_A.question: What is ...with you? – I’m cold and hungry!
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "the matter"

part_A.question: The scientists in the world are _ _ _ _ _ research on AIDS.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "doing" → "doing" = dạng -ing (hiện tại/quá khứ tiếp diễn) dùng với "is/are/was/were".

part_A.question: I hope that he will get b_ _ _ _ _ soon.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "etter" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "better". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: Why don’t we go … a walk?
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "for B. in C. with D. about"

part_A.question: What was the food ...? – It was delicious.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "like B. love C. think D. favorite"

part_A.question: She walks to school. It means she goes to school on _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "foot" → "on foot" (đi bộ).

part_A.question: You should take a hot shower right now or you may catch a _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "cold" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: You should take a hot shower right now or you may catch a [cold] _ _ _ .

part_A.question: Mary … in the dance sport club since last year.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "has participated"

part_A.question: A gymnast must be very ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "strong"

part_A.question: _ _ _ _ _ did you go last night? – Oh, I went to the cinema.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "where" → Từ để hỏi "where" → câu trả lời "Oh, I went to the cinema." cho thấy đây là hỏi về địa điểm.

part_A.question: … are going to the cinema this evening.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "My brother and I"

part_A.question: Can you give me …?
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "a ride B. a drive C. riding D. driving"

part_A.question: When it becomes hot, people often feel th_ _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "irsty" → Từ đầy đủ: "thirsty" = khát nước.

part_A.question: … seeing beautiful sites, visitors enjoy traditional food.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "As well as" → Từ phù hợp với ngữ nghĩa câu. "traditional": truyền thống (tính từ).

part_A.question: The man looked .... He spoke ... to us.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "sad / sadly"

part_A.question: Jackson is a common English _ _ _ e.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "nam" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Jackson is a common English [nam] _ _ e.

part_A.question: The wind blew very ….
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "hard B. fast C. quickly D. soon"

part_A.question: ’’Can you play the piano?’’ Adam a_ _ _ _ the girl.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "sked" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "asked". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ are you going to stay here? – Just 2 days.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "long" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: How [long] _ _ _ are you going to stay here? – Just 2 days.

part_A.question: Does she always have lunch _ _ _ _ her friends?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "with" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Does she always have lunch [with] _ _ _ her friends?

part_A.question: You ought to learn how to _ _ _ _ this musical instrument.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "play" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: You ought to learn how to [play] _ _ _ this musical instrument.

part_A.question: ’’…’’ has opposite meaning to ’’…’’.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "Full / thin B. Full / low C. Full / heavy D. Full / weight"

part_A.question: How did you come back from the school festival …?
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "last night B. tomorrow C. now D. today" → Từ phù hợp với ngữ nghĩa câu. "festival": lễ hội, liên hoan.

part_A.question: What is her …? – She is Australian.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "nationality"

part_A.question: My dad _ _ _ _ times goes jogging when he has free time.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "some" → "How some" hỏi về số lượng đếm được.

part_A.question: She avoided … at him when she spoke.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "looking B. to look C. looked D. look"

part_A.question: Zidane is _ _ _ _ _ the greatest football players in the world.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "among" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Zidane is [among] _ _ _ _ the greatest football players in the world.

part_A.question: Children should spend only a small part of their free time playing electronic _ _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "games" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Children should spend only a small part of their free time playing electronic [games] _ _ _ _ .

part_A.question: I’m having an exam tomorrow. – _ _ _ _ luck!
part_A.explanation: Điền: "good" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: I’m having an exam tomorrow. – [good] _ _ _ luck!

part_A.question: … – That one.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "Which is your house? B. Where is your father? C. Is that your book? D. What is that book?"

part_A.question: Mrs. Rebecca looks younger in her new str_ _ _ _ skirt.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "iped" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "striped". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: A _ _ _ _ _ bor is a person who lives near your house.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "neigh" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: A [neigh] _ _ _ _ bor is a person who lives near your house.

part_A.question: ...? – Because she studies English very well.
options: A. How does she speak English?
B. Why does she speak English well?
C. Why can’t she speak English well?
D. How is she speaking English well?
part_A.answer: B. Why does she speak English well?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Why does she speak English well?"

part_A.question: Dogs are ... pets.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "friendly B. friend C. friend’ D. friends"

part_A.question: John enjoys … tennis.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "playing B. play C. played D. to play"

part_A.question: I gave her a present yesterday. It means ....
options: A. she got a present from me yesterday
B. she brought me a present yesterday
C. she took a present for me yesterday
part_A.answer: A. she got a present from me yesterday
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "she got a present from me yesterday B. she brought me a present yesterday C. she took a present for me yesterday D. all are correct" → "she got a present from me yesterday B. she brought me a present yesterday C. she took a present for me yesterday D. all are correct": chọn từ đồng nghĩa với từ được in đậm/gạch chân trong câu hỏi.

part_A.question: Farmers are very hard-working. They work from morning _ _ _ _ night on their farms.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "till" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Farmers are very hard-working. They work from morning [till] _ _ _ night on their farms.

part_A.question: _ _ _ _ _ I carry that luggage for you? – Thanks.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "could" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: [could] _ _ _ _ I carry that luggage for you? – Thanks.

part_A.question: Where is the supermarket? – It’s ... the hospital.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "on the right of"

part_A.question: What ... you do the last time you ... a bad toothache?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "did / had"

part_A.question: _ _ _ _ _ day of the week is the School’s festival day?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "which" → "which" = hỏi về thông tin.

part_A.question: I spoke very slowly … he didn’t understand English very well.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "because"

part_A.question: It’s difficult to cross this street because there is too much … .
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "traffic"

part_A.question: Our Music class will finish soon. “Soon” here means ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "in a short time" → "in a short time": chọn từ đồng nghĩa với từ được in đậm/gạch chân trong câu hỏi.

part_A.question: She will finish all her homework in less _ _ _ _ 2 hours.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "than" → "fewer ... than" = so sánh hơn với danh từ đếm được (stamps, books, students...). "less ... than" dùng với không đếm được.

part_A.question: She bought some souvenirs _ _ _ _ the shop and so did I.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "from" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: She bought some souvenirs [from] _ _ _ the shop and so did I.

part_A.question: Please fill in your medical _ _ _ _ _ ds for having a medical check-up.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "recor" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Please fill in your medical [recor] _ _ _ _ ds for having a medical check-up.

part_A.question: My aunt has two children, one boy and one _ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "girl" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: My aunt has two children, one boy and one [girl] _ _ _ .

part_A.question: I am sleepy. I … go to bed early.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "must B. have to C. can D. mustn’t"

part_A.question: I’m from Great Britain. I’m Bri_ _ _ _ .
part_A.explanation: Điền: "tish" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "british". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: My aunt tells us a lot _ _ _ _ _ you.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "about" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: My aunt tells us a lot [about] _ _ _ _ you.

part_A.question: Every night I like to _ _ _ _ the internet for about an hour to find interesting information on the web!
part_A.explanation: Điền: "surf" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Every night I like to [surf] _ _ _ the internet for about an hour to find interesting information on the web!

part_A.question: ...! It’s late.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Go home now"

part_A.question: In the class, nobody’s eaten Chinese food and … I.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "neither have"

part_A.question: I’m back _ _ _ _ school and I’m hungry.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "from" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: I’m back [from] _ _ _ school and I’m hungry.

part_A.question: Her _ _ _ _ of birth is on July 2nd.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "date" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Her [date] _ _ _ of birth is on July 2nd.

part_A.question: ... to keep fit and stay healthy.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "It is important"

part_A.question: Another word for “fall” is “au_ _ _ _ ”.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "tumn" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "autumn". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: It rained ... last week and I couldn’t go out.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "a lot B. lots C. many D. a few"

part_A.question: She is trying to … her work before the coming exam.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "review"

part_A.question: The child is ... because she wants to go to bed now.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "sleepy"

part_A.question: Can’t you speak English?
options: A. Yes. I can speak Spanish but I can’t speak English.
B. Yes. I can speak English well.
C. No. I can speak English well.
D. No. I can speak Spanish, too.
part_A.answer: B. Yes. I can speak English well.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Yes. I can speak English well." → Từ phù hợp với ngữ nghĩa câu. "speak": nói (speak a language / speak to somebody).

part_A.question: The synonym of ’’fix’’ is:
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "mend B. solve C. damage D. make"

part_A.question: A note to inform you are ill is a _ _ _ _ note.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "sick" → "sick" = ốm, buồn nôn (sick ≠ "sore" là đau nhức).

part_A.question: Will you help me … the floor?
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "clean B. not clean C. cleaning D. cleaned"

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ _ do you visit your relatives? – Once a week.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "often" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: How [often] _ _ _ _ do you visit your relatives? – Once a week.

part_A.question: I can’t listen to your story now. I have ... time.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "little"

part_A.question: Did you play volleyball _ _ _ _ week? – No, I didn’t.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "last" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Did you play volleyball [last] _ _ _ week? – No, I didn’t.

part_A.question: Every boys and girls j_ _ _ _ the activity enthusiastically.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "oins" → Từ hoàn chỉnh: "joins". Điền phần còn thiếu.

part_A.question: She has a … ruler.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "long white"

part_A.question: Is this your car? – No, it’s ....
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "Mr. Brown’s"

part_A.question: He sat there and watched the artist … the whole picture.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "drawing"

part_A.question: How much does it _ _ _ _ to mail a local letter in Vietnam?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "cost" → "cost" = tốn kém, có giá (How much does it cost? = Giá bao nhiêu?).

part_A.question: Baseball is different … soccer.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "from B. of C. for D. with"

part_A.question: Staying at _ _ _ _ would be better than going out tonight.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "home" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Staying at [home] _ _ _ would be better than going out tonight.

part_A.question: _ _ _ _ you ever been to Ho Chi Minh city?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "have" → "have/has" trong thì hiện tại hoàn thành (Present Perfect). Dấu hiệu: ever.

part_A.question: What did they do last Monday? – They ....
options: D. did went to the movies
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "went swimming"

part_A.question: … straight across the road.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "Don’t run B. Not run C. No run D. Can’t run"

part_A.question: Are ... any pictures in your house?
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "there B. this C. that D. those"

part_A.question: Everyday Jane _ _ _ _ up at 6.00 and has breakfast with her parents.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "gets" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Everyday Jane [gets] _ _ _ up at 6.00 and has breakfast with her parents.

part_A.question: Did someone help you draw the picture? – No, I did it ….
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "myself"

part_A.question: Long _ _ _ _ down the stairs this morning and broke his leg.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "fell" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Long [fell] _ _ _ down the stairs this morning and broke his leg.

part_A.question: _ _ _ _ is the tall building over there? - It’s a new library.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "What" → Từ để hỏi "What" → câu trả lời "It’s a new library." cho thấy đây là hỏi về thứ/vật gì.

part_A.question: How long will it _ _ _ _ you to get there?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "take" → "take" = mất (thời gian): "It takes ... to do".

part_A.question: I don’t have ... rulers, but I have ... erasers.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "any / some B. some / any C. a little / any D. some / a little"

part_A.question: Which is the correct spelling?
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "September"

part_A.question: Clara often does all her homework ... night.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "at B. in C. on D. for"

part_A.question: Farah has ... hair.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "short curly B. curly short C. short’s curly D. curl short"

part_A.question: What _ _ _ _ _ going by bus? – Nice idea!
part_A.explanation: Điền: "about" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: What [about] _ _ _ _ going by bus? – Nice idea!

part_A.question: How far is it _ _ _ _ here to your house?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "from" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: How far is it [from] _ _ _ here to your house?

part_A.question: Do you need to use a very sharp _ _ _ _ _ to cut the flower?
part_A.explanation: Điền: "knife" → Câu hoàn chỉnh: Do you need to use a very sharp [knife] _ _ _ _ to cut the flower?

part_A.question: Is there anything good … TV tonight?
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "on B. in C. near D. at"

part_A.question: The old woman explained to us ... to the police station.
part_A.explanation: Đáp án: "how to get"

part_A.question: The medicines ... the symptoms of the common cold.
part_A.explanation: Chọn A. "relieve B. disappear C. catch D. prevents" → Từ phù hợp với ngữ nghĩa câu. "medicine": thuốc; y học (take medicine = uống thuốc).

part_A.question: I’m going to learn to drive. I never had time to learn _ _ _ _ I was younger.
part_A.explanation: Điền: "when" → "when" = hỏi về thời gian.

part_A.question: You have to work h_ _ _ _ _ when you grow up.

part_A.question: ’’How are you?’’ – ’’Very well, _ _ _ _ _ you. And you?’’

part_A.question: Do you enjoy _ _ _ _ _ given gifts by the others on your birthday?

part_A.question: How _ _ _ _ _ do you visit your grandparents, Tien? – Every month.
